findings.issue: The app ships with no test script, runner, or single test file; all quality gating is deferred to the harness-provided acceptance suite.
findings.suggestion: Add vitest plus a few unit suites for app/src/lib/format.ts and the pure transforms in app/src/server/pokeapi.ts (they take plain objects, so small JSON fixtures suffice).

findings.issue: Sorting correctness (missing values last in both directions, stable tie-break, ascending-first toggling, aria-sort) is enforced only by acceptance tests.
findings.suggestion: Unit-test the sort comparator directly with mixed null/number/string rows for both directions; it is a pure function of (rows, sort).

findings.issue: speciesIndex builds the home list by joining species names, 18 type pokemon lists and generations; slot ordering, empty-type fallback and generation assignment are all untested.
findings.suggestion: Extract the join into a pure function taking the three raw payloads and test ordering/dedup with a fixture including an alternate form and a species missing from a type list.

findings.issue: Debounced URL sync and the query === (search.q ?? '') gate at line 64 are a race-prone design with no regression net; a refactor could reintroduce typing lag or break the reset-to-page-1 rule.
findings.suggestion: Cover with a component test: type a query, assert results update before the URL settles; change a select, assert page resets.

findings.issue: Alternate-form exclusion (id > 10000), dedupe-by-id, and the species-name fallback in toCards protect every 'Learned by'/'Pokémon of type' card list from duplicates and wrong links.
findings.suggestion: Unit-test toCards with refs including an id above 10000, a duplicate id, and an id absent from the species map.

findings.issue: The default game is the highest-order version group, but unknown version groups fall back to MAX_SAFE_INTEGER and sort last, silently becoming the default; tie-breaks by name. Nothing pins this.
findings.suggestion: Test the games/default selection with a fixture containing two version groups of equal order and one missing from /version-group/.

findings.issue: The cache memo's semantics (shared promise, eviction of rejections, 60s TTL vs live-data changes) are untested; a refactor caching resolved values would pin a 404/500 or serve stale data past the TTL.
findings.suggestion: Unit-test memo with a fake timer: concurrent callers share one promise, a rejection is evicted and retried, an expired entry recomputes.

findings.issue: latestEnglish uses .at(-1) and collapse uses a \s+ regex; the classic silent regression is switching to the first English entry or dropping the collapse, and no test would notice.
findings.suggestion: One-line unit tests for both helpers with multi-language entries containing \n and \f.

findings.issue: validateSearch coerces page (NaN, 0, 1 all normalised to undefined); a regression would make ?page=0 slice to an empty list.
findings.suggestion: Unit-test validateSearch with ?page=0, ?page=abc, ?page=1 and blank q/type/generation.

findings.issue: The root head reads the router-internal m._notFound field to pick the 404 title; nothing would catch this breaking on a router upgrade.
findings.suggestion: Add a smoke test asserting the document title for a not-found URL, or drop the private field in favour of the documented m.status.

summary: The app contains no tests of its own: no test script, no runner, and no spec files anywhere in app/. That is a significant miss because the code is deliberately structured for cheap testing — pure helpers in app/src/lib/format.ts and pure transforms in app/src/server/pokeapi.ts that accept plain objects. The riskiest logic (the species-index join, move-table sorting, debounce/URL/page interplay, alternate-form exclusion, and the runtime cache) is entirely unguarded once the acceptance suite is no longer the gate.

untested.area: Move-table sorting (app/src/components/MoveTable.tsx:47-62): null-last in both directions, stable-index tie-break, ascending-first toggle, aria-sort state
untested.likelyBug: A flipped comparison or reordered null check makes missing power/accuracy sort first when descending, or breaks the second-click direction flip — visually correct tables become wrong with no failing test.

untested.area: Species-index construction (app/src/server/pokeapi.ts:172-198): joining species names × 18 type pokemon lists × generations, slot ordering, empty-type and missing-generation fallbacks
untested.likelyBug: A slot-sort typo or an id-filter change reorders or empties the type badges on every home-page card, or drops species whose types are absent (e.g. data added after the build).

untested.area: Search + debounce + URL sync + page clamp (app/src/routes/index.tsx:33-46, 63-68)
untested.likelyBug: Regating on search.q instead of the typed query reintroduces typing lag; a broken clamp makes ?page=0 or an out-of-range page render an empty list or duplicate page numbers.
Changing id > 10000 to >= 10000, or losing the map dedupe, duplicates or wrongly links cards on ability, type and move 'Learned by' lists (e.g. deoxys-normal pointing at the wrong species).

untested.area: Default game selection and version-group ordering (app/src/server/functions.ts:52-64)
untested.likelyBug: Unknown version groups fall back to MAX_SAFE_INTEGER and sort last, silently becoming the default game; a tie-break change picks the wrong default and reorders the Game select.

untested.area: Method ordering for learn tables (app/src/server/functions.ts:67-83): Level Up, Machine, Egg, Tutor, then others alphabetically
untested.likelyBug: A typo in METHOD_ORDER or switching to raw-name sort puts Egg before Machine or alphabetises the fixed four, breaking the required table order.

untested.area: English-name / latest-flavor extraction and whitespace collapse (app/src/server/pokeapi.ts:75-79)
untested.likelyBug: Switching .at(-1) to .find() silently picks the first English entry instead of the latest, or dropping collapse leaves raw \n/\f in flavor text.

untested.area: Runtime cache memo (app/src/server/pokeapi.ts:18-31): shared promises, rejection eviction, TTL vs live data, size pruning
untested.likelyBug: A refactor that caches resolved values instead of promises pins a 404/500 for the TTL or serves stale data past it, breaking the live-data-overlay requirement.
page=0/NaN coercion regressions slice to an empty list; matching raw s.name instead of humanize(name) breaks 'Mr Mime' search.

untested.area: Root head/title logic including the private m._notFound field (app/src/routes/__root.tsx:13)
untested.likelyBug: A router upgrade renames the internal field and every 404 page silently gets the wrong document title.
